title: Two Pointers and Sliding Window Quiz
description: A quick check to review two pointers and sliding window patterns.

questions.question: When is the two pointers pattern often useful?

options.text: When comparing values from two positions in a sorted list

questions.explanation: Two pointers are often useful when working with sorted lists or comparing values from different positions.

questions.question: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
numbers = [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2]
k = 3

window_sum = sum(numbers[0:k])
max_sum = window_sum

for i in range(k, len(numbers)):
    window_sum += numbers[i]
    window_sum -= numbers[i - k]
    max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)

print(max_sum)
questions.explanation: The maximum sum of 3 consecutive numbers is 5 + 1 + 3 = 9.
